title: Kingdome 19 Universal

description.main: A photobook of male nudes by the German photographer Henning von Berg, credited jointly with Kingdome 19 and published by Bruno Gmünder in Berlin in 2004.
description.extended:
Universal is a 2004 photobook of male nude photography by Henning von Berg, credited jointly with the artist name Kingdome 19.

The Getty Research Institute catalogues it as a cased volume of about 25 cm, unpaged and mostly illustrated, some plates in colour, under the subjects erotic photography, photography of the nude and the male nude in art. It was issued by Bruno Gmünder in Berlin.

Von Berg was born in Hannover in 1961 and worked for thirteen years as a planning engineer before becoming a freelance photographer in 1997 after moving to Cologne. His early group shoots combined nude models with industrial architecture, and his 1999 project Naked Berlin photographed male nudes at the Reichstag and other Berlin landmarks. Kingdome 19 appears as co-author on two Universal editions, from 2004 and 2008.
description.artist_bio: Born 1961 in Hannover; freelance photographer since 1997; Naked Berlin (1999); Naked Sydney (2005).

notes: Title uncertain: brief said 'Kingdome 19'. The book's cover reads 'Kingdome 19 / universal / Henning von Berg'; Getty lists artist 'Kingdome 19', title 'Universal'. Recorded as 'Kingdome 19 Universal' (AbeBooks/OpenLibrary form). Alternative ISBN 9783867816557 is a mis-keyed AbeBooks/OpenLibrary variant of the same book (Getty confirms 9783861876557). Pages unresolved: one AbeBooks listing says 160, Getty says unpaged. Kingdome 19's identity unexplained by sources. Later edition 2008 mentioned on de.wikipedia.
